rca of the issue: RESOLVED. Root cause (iter-111): hydrateGuest stripped menu_item_id/restaurant_id before the quote-builder useEffect ran, so the one-line builder fix in iter-110 was dead code. Fix (iter-112, verified): BakedContexts.jsx lines 371-372 (guest hydrate) and 467-468 (authed load) now push `menu_item_id: it.menu_item_id` and `restaurant_id: s.restaurant_id || it.restaurant_id`. Verified empirically: review-spec seed produces exactly 1 POST /api/cart/quote with the correct 2-item payload, backend returns delivery_fee=29, UI renders ₹507 total on both desktop drawer and mobile /cart.
